CYBERPUNK.Name: Name
CYBERPUNK.MartialArtBonusesHint: Per-action bonuses for this style. Used when the skill is selected as the Martial Art for an attack.
CYBERPUNK.NeedsRecharge: Cannot fire: power cell depleted. Recharge (reload) first — energy weapons don't use ammunition.
CYBERPUNK.Head: Head
CYBERPUNK.BlockParryText: Stop attacks with an object. Swords won't take damage, but must make a save to avoid breaking. You get -3 to your actions while blocking or parrying.
CYBERPUNK.DodgeText: -2 to attackers' hit rolls. You get -3 to your actions while dodging.
CYBERPUNK.DisarmText: Succeed? Opponent's weapon no longer in their hands.
CYBERPUNK.HoldText: Succeed? Opponent immobilized until escape made.
CYBERPUNK.EscapeText: Succeed? Their limbs are a prison that cannot hold you. You're free of opponent's Hold.
CYBERPUNK.SweepTripText: Succeed? Opponent knocked to ground, they get -2 to their next attack, and you get +2 to your next.
CYBERPUNK.GrappleText: Succeed? Great, now you can try to Hold, Choke or Throw your opponent.
CYBERPUNK.DodgeHint: Defensive: incoming melee attacks take -2 to hit this turn. You're at -3 to your own actions while dodging.
CYBERPUNK.BlockParryHint: Defensive: block or parry an incoming melee attack outright — no damage if you win the contest. Blades must save or break. -3 to your actions while blocking.
CYBERPUNK.StrikeHint: Punch attack — 1D3 + STR damage bonus + martial-art bonus. Contested vs the target's defense.
CYBERPUNK.KickHint: Kick attack — 1D6 + STR damage bonus + martial-art bonus. Hits harder than a strike. Contested.
CYBERPUNK.DisarmHint: Knock the target's weapon out of their hands on a successful contested roll.
CYBERPUNK.SweepTripHint: Knock the target prone: -2 to their next attack, +2 to yours. They must spend an action to stand.
CYBERPUNK.GrappleHint: Grab the target. While grappled you can Hold, Choke, or Throw them as a free action on later turns.
CYBERPUNK.HoldHint: Immobilize a grabbed target until they break free with Escape.
CYBERPUNK.ChokeHint: Strangle a held target: 1D6 damage per turn, and they must pass a Stun Save each turn or fall unconscious.
CYBERPUNK.ThrowHint: Throw the target down: 1D6 + STR damage and knocked prone (they must spend an action to stand).
CYBERPUNK.EscapeHint: Break free from an opponent's Hold or Grapple on a successful contested roll.
CYBERPUNK.PunchHint: Basic punch — 1D3 + STR damage bonus + martial-art bonus. Contested melee strike.
CYBERPUNK.RamHint: FNFF2: charging body-slam — drive into the target with your momentum.
CYBERPUNK.JumpKickHint: FNFF2: leaping kick — higher damage than a standard kick.
CYBERPUNK.CastHint: FNFF2: a throwing maneuver — hurl the opponent using their own momentum.
CYBERPUNK.AllOutParryHint: FNFF2: commit your whole turn to parrying for a strong defensive bonus — you can't attack.
CYBERPUNK.AllOutDodgeHint: FNFF2: commit your whole turn to dodging for a strong defensive bonus — you can't attack.
CYBERPUNK.AmmoTrackingHint: When on, weapons can't fire on an empty magazine — reload to draw from linked ammo. Turn off for Free Fire (ammo ignored, infinite reloads).
CYBERPUNK.SuppressiveDesc: Each creature inside or crossing the fire-zone rolls Athletics + REF + 1d10 vs DC ({save}).
CYBERPUNK.SuppressiveHitsDesc: On failure the target suffers 1D6 hits; each hit deals {dmg} damage to a random location.
CYBERPUNK.ReputationHint: Your social standing (CP2020 p.54). GM-set; can be negative for cowardice/infamy. Feeds the Facedown and Recognition rolls.
CYBERPUNK.FacedownHint: Roll 1d10 + COOL + Reputation. Target one foe's token first to make it a contested Facedown.
CYBERPUNK.FacedownSoloHint: Target one foe's token to make this a contested Facedown.
CYBERPUNK.FacedownPenalty: {loser} backs down — or is at −3 vs {winner} until they win a Facedown against them. (GM enforces.)
CYBERPUNK.FacedownTie: Tie — neither side backs down; no penalty.
CYBERPUNK.RecognitionHint: Roll 1d10 vs your Reputation: at or under = they recognize you; over = they haven't heard of you.
CYBERPUNK.RecognizedNo: Not recognized — rolled {roll} > Rep {rep}. They haven't heard of {name}.
CYBERPUNK.UnderThresholdMessage: Roll under the thresholds to succeed
CYBERPUNK.ItemDeleteConfirmText: Are you sure you want to delete {itemName}?
CYBERPUNK.DragItemsPrompt: Drag items here to add (for now)
CYBERPUNK.InitiativeTrackerWarning: At the moment, rolling initiative from the sheet doesn't add to the encounter's combat tracker.
CYBERPUNK.KeyTechniqueWarning: Key technique bonuses for martial arts aren't implemented yet
SETTINGS.TrainedSkillsFirstHint: Whether trained skills always come first in the skills list
SETTINGS.FNFF2EnabledHint: Enable the optional Friday Night Fistfight 2 martial arts ruleset (new styles, actions, and opposed roll flow).
SETTINGS.RestrictMovementOncePerTurn: Combat: Restrict Movement to Once per Turn
SETTINGS.RestrictMovementOncePerTurnHint: When enabled, during an active combat a combatant may reposition freely until they take a tracked action this turn (such as firing a weapon); after acting, further movement is blocked until the next round (CP2020 p.99: one move plus one action per turn). The GM can always move tokens (override). Off by default.
CYBERPUNK.NoCombatError: There's currently no combat encounter present; you'll need to start one
CYBERPUNK.NoAmmo: Cannot fire: magazine empty. Reload first.
CYBERPUNK.NoAmmoInventory: Cannot fire: no ammunition in inventory. Add/link ammo, or turn off Ammo Tracking (Free Fire).
CYBERPUNK.FireModeNotCapable: This weapon isn't capable of that fire mode.
CYBERPUNK.NoLinkedAmmo: No linked ammunition in inventory to reload from. Link ammo on the weapon, or turn off Ammo Tracking (Free Fire).
CYBERPUNK.AmmoCaliberMismatch: Wrong caliber: this weapon chambers {weapon}, but the selected ammo is {ammo}.
CYBERPUNK.AmmoUnloadFirst: A different ammo type is loaded. Unload the magazine before loading this type.
CYBERPUNK.UnloadedNoSource: Unloaded {count} round(s). No tracked ammo source to return them to.
CYBERPUNK.AmmoBuyNoBoxSize: Set a Box Size greater than 0 before buying.
CYBERPUNK.AmmoBuyInsufficientFunds: Not enough eurobucks: a box costs {cost}eb but you only have {funds}eb.
CYBERPUNK.AmmoBought: Bought a box of {count} round(s) for {cost}eb.

CYBERPUNK.WaitForTurnBtnTitle: Wait for Turn — skip this slot and act after a chosen combatant

CYBERPUNK.DodgeTitleActive: Dodging (−2 to attacker's melee roll this round) — click to cancel
CYBERPUNK.ParryTitle: Declare Parry (block next melee attack, −3 to own other actions)
CYBERPUNK.ParryTitleActive: Parrying (next melee attack blocked) — click to cancel
CYBERPUNK.AddActionTitle: Manual Action — mark an action not tracked automatically (e.g., reload, mount/dismount)
CYBERPUNK.DodgeDeclareBody: All incoming melee attacks this round are at −2 to the attacker's roll. Dodge clears at the start of {name}'s next turn. (CP2020 p.102)
CYBERPUNK.ParryDeclareBody: The next incoming melee attack is automatically blocked. Parry is consumed on first use. The parrying character takes −3 to all other actions this turn. (CP2020 p.102)
CYBERPUNK.ActNowBody: Use the character sheet to fire weapons or take actions.
CYBERPUNK.YourMomentBody: {name} just acted. Click ⚡ in the tracker to announce your delayed action, then fire from your character sheet.
CYBERPUNK.WaitingBody: Acting after {target}. A prompt will appear when their turn ends.
CYBERPUNK.AcidExpiredBody: ⚗ {name} — Acid effect at {location} expired. Armor SP degradation complete.
CYBERPUNK.StillHeldBody: 🤜 {name} is still held by {holder}. Can only attempt Escape this turn.
CYBERPUNK.GrappledReminderBody: 🤜 {name} is grappled by {grappler}. Must escape or the grappler may Hold/Choke/Throw freely.
CYBERPUNK.StabilizedLostBody: ⚠ {name} was stabilized but has taken new damage — Death Saves are required again.
CYBERPUNK.ConcussionBody: 💥 {name} — concussion ({weapon}): {permanent} permanent HP (half of {gotThrough} after BTM); the other half is stun. Soft armor −2 SP. Stun Save required.
CYBERPUNK.ScatterBody: 🎲 Scatter — {dir}{drift}. Reposition if needed, then Confirm Blast.
CYBERPUNK.GasCloudPlacedBody:
Gas cloud placed on canvas (radius {radius}m). All tokens within the cloud must make Stun Saves each turn (penalty {mod}).
Cloud persists for {duration} turns, then disperses automatically. GM may reposition the template to represent wind drift.
CYBERPUNK.GasCloudTurnBody: In the gas cloud: {names}. Each must make a Stun Save{penalty}.
CYBERPUNK.ExplosionConfirmSummary: Blast radius {radius}m, base damage {damage}, full damage within {within}m.
CYBERPUNK.ExplosionConfirmHint: If the throw missed, click Scatter to roll where it really lands; otherwise reposition for cover and click Confirm. Damage falls off by distance.
CYBERPUNK.SpreadConfirmHint: Aim the pattern, then click Confirm. Everyone in the straight path is hit (CP2020 p.108).
CYBERPUNK.StunSaveNeed: Must roll ≤ {threshold} on 1d10 to stay conscious
CYBERPUNK.StunSaveResultWin: ✅ SUCCESS (rolled {result} ≤ {threshold}) — {name} stays in the fight.
CYBERPUNK.StunSaveRecoveryNote: Can recover by rolling a successful Stun Save on a subsequent turn.
CYBERPUNK.DeathSaveAutoWarn: ⚠ Automatic death — threshold is 0, no roll can succeed.
CYBERPUNK.DeathSaveNeed: Must roll ≤ {threshold} on 1d10 to survive this turn
CYBERPUNK.DeathSaveAutoResult: ☠ AUTOMATIC DEATH — Death Save threshold is 0 (roll ≤ 0 on 1d10 is impossible). {name} dies.
CYBERPUNK.DeathSaveResultWin: ✅ SURVIVED (rolled {result} ≤ {threshold}) — {name} clings to life. Another save required next turn.
CYBERPUNK.DeathSaveResultLose: ☠ DIED (rolled {result} > {threshold}) — {name} dies at end of this turn. Call Trauma Team.
CYBERPUNK.StabilizeHint: Stabilize: TECH + Medical + 1d10 ≥ total damage ({damage} pts)
CYBERPUNK.StabilizeDialogIntro: TECH + Medical Skill + 1d10 must equal or exceed {damage} total damage.
CYBERPUNK.StabilizeMedLabel: Medical Skill (Medical Tech or First Aid)
CYBERPUNK.StabilizeResultWin: ✅ STABILIZED — Roll total: {breakdown} ≥ {damage}. No further Death Saves required.
CYBERPUNK.StabilizeResultLose: ❌ FAILED — Roll total: {breakdown} < {damage}. Death Saves continue next turn.
CYBERPUNK.StabilizeResultNote: If new damage is taken, stabilization is lost and Death Saves restart.
CYBERPUNK.Vehicle.MMDisabledMissile: Maximum Metal is disabled — enable it in the settings to fire guided missiles.
CYBERPUNK.Vehicle.MissileNeedsTokens: Missile launch needs both the firer and the target on the canvas.
CYBERPUNK.Vehicle.MissileNoCombatHint: ⚠ No active encounter — start one for automatic flight, or advance the missile manually with ▶ in the Missiles in Flight panel (Combat tab).
CYBERPUNK.Vehicle.MissileLaunchedNotice: Missile launched — start an encounter for better missile controls, or advance it manually in the Combat tab's Missiles in Flight panel.
CYBERPUNK.Vehicle.AntiMissileBurstBody: {weapon} will hit at HALF damage & Penetration.
CYBERPUNK.Vehicle.NoCmDefeats: No countermeasure defeats this missile's homing method.
CYBERPUNK.Vehicle.DamageDisabled: Vehicle damage automation is disabled in the settings.
CYBERPUNK.Vehicle.ChemicalBurstBody: A {radius}m cloud settles over the impact.
CYBERPUNK.Vehicle.IndirectNeedsTarget: Target the impact point (a token at the target's location) before firing indirect.
CYBERPUNK.Vehicle.IndirectIntro: {actor} fires {weapon} indirect at {target}. A spotter corrects fire; on a miss the shell scatters from the aim point.
CYBERPUNK.Vehicle.BombNeedsTarget: Target the aiming point (a token at the target's location) before bombing.
CYBERPUNK.Vehicle.BombIntro: {actor} drops {weapon} on {target}. A direct hit multiplies Penetration ×5; a miss scatters with altitude.
CYBERPUNK.Vehicle.DiveTurnsTip: Turns spent diving at the target; each beyond the first adds +1 to-hit (max +3) and speeds the fall.
CYBERPUNK.Vehicle.AircraftSpeedTip: Power-dive speed; the bomb inherits it (halving each turn to the 175 m/turn floor).
CYBERPUNK.Vehicle.AcpaMeleeOnlyAcpa: ACPA melee is for powered-armor actors (tick the ACPA box).
CYBERPUNK.Vehicle.AcpaNeedTarget: Target the token you're striking first.
CYBERPUNK.Vehicle.RepairOnlyAcpa: Repair is for ACPA (powered armor) only.
CYBERPUNK.Vehicle.AcpaRepaired: {actor} fully repaired (frame SOP, systems & weapons restored).
CYBERPUNK.Vehicle.PilotRefTip: Pilot REF, capped by the suit's Reflex/Control system (derived effective REF). Override if a different pilot is driving.
CYBERPUNK.Vehicle.LuckHitBody: Struck by a Penetration {pen} weapon. Roll LUCK + 1d10 vs 15 (MM p.8).
CYBERPUNK.Vehicle.LuckHitNote: Success = grazed (5D6, half armor). Failure = Penetration vs your Armor Value. LUCK {luck}.
CYBERPUNK.Vehicle.LuckGrazed: GRAZED — {dmg} (5D6) to {loc}, armor at half SP.
CYBERPUNK.Vehicle.LuckStopped: Armor stopped it (Pen {pen} ≤ AV {av}) — {dmg} (2D6) impact to {loc}; armor loses {spStripped} SP.
CYBERPUNK.Vehicle.LuckPenetrated: PENETRATED (Pen {pen} − AV {av} = {diff}) — {dmg} damage to {loc}; armor destroyed.
CYBERPUNK.Vehicle.ControlDisabled: Vehicle control rolls are disabled in the system settings.
CYBERPUNK.Vehicle.ManeuverExamples_simpl: swerve, take off / land, hover, rotate, mild turn
CYBERPUNK.Vehicle.ManeuverExamples_diffi: tight turn, control a skid, emergency stop, pull out of a dive, reverse
CYBERPUNK.Vehicle.ManeuverExamples_veryD: bootlegger reverse, extremely tight turn, vertical aerial maneuver, regain control from a spin
CYBERPUNK.Vehicle.ControlFail: ❌ FAILED — control lost (rolled below DV by {missedBy}).
CYBERPUNK.Vehicle.FireNoTargetClause: (no target — apply from the chat card afterward)
CYBERPUNK.Vehicle.ArcWarnStrict: ⛔ Target is to the {bearing} of the firer — outside the {arc} mount's arc. Strict arc blocks this shot: rotate the firing vehicle to face the target (Ctrl+scroll), or use a turret mount.
CYBERPUNK.Vehicle.ArcWarnSoft: ⚠ Target is to the {bearing} of the firer — outside the {arc} mount's arc. You can still fire (override).
CYBERPUNK.Vehicle.ShellTip: Choose the loaded round; the choice is saved on the weapon. Hi-Ex/HEAT shells set their own Penetration, burst and range-immunity.
CYBERPUNK.Vehicle.FireControlTip: The vehicle's fire-control / targeting-computer bonus (system.fireControl), auto-applied. Edit to add an ad-hoc bonus on top.
CYBERPUNK.Vehicle.DFBTip: ACPA Direct-Fire Bonus from the suit's Reality Interface (system.dfb), auto-applied when the suit fires its own weapons (replaces a smartgun bonus).
CYBERPUNK.Vehicle.FireApplyHint: No target selected. Target the enemy token (vehicle or person), then:
CYBERPUNK.Vehicle.FireMultiToken: {actor} has multiple tokens on this scene — select the one you're firing from so facing and arc use the right token.
CYBERPUNK.Vehicle.ArcStrictBlock: Strict arc — target is to the {bearing} of the firer, outside the {arc} mount's arc. Rotate to bear or use a turret.
CYBERPUNK.Vehicle.MissileNeedTokensDirec: Missiles need the firer and target on the canvas — resolving as a direct shot.
CYBERPUNK.Vehicle.ApplyTargetOne: Target exactly one token (vehicle or person), then click Apply.

SETTINGS.FumbleTableEnabledHint: If enabled, whenever a skill check rolls a natural 1, the result is also determined using the fumble table.
SETTINGS.AutomationNoticeHide: Hide the Setup / What's New notice
SETTINGS.AutomationNoticeHideHint: When checked, the Cyberpunk 2020 setup & what's-new dialog stops appearing on load for the GM. Uncheck to see it again. (The notice's own 'Don't show this again' checkbox sets this too.)
SETTINGS.PlayersCanBuyAmmoHint: When off, only the GM can buy ammo; players are told they must purchase it at a shop and should ask the GM. Keeps ammo from appearing out of thin air.
SETTINGS.AmmoLockerEnabledHint: Optional, off by default. When on, any miscellaneous item can be turned into an 'Ammo Locker' (an in-inventory button that opens the ammo purchasing dialog). Leave off to buy ammo from the shop catalog's Ammo section instead.
SETTINGS.AmmoBlackhandsBoxes: Use Blackhand's Guide ammo box sizes
SETTINGS.AmmoBlackhandsBoxesHint: Optional. Switches firearm ammunition to Blackhand's Guide's uniform box-of-100 pricing instead of the Core rulebook's per-class box sizes. Default off (Core).
SETTINGS.AmmoBlackhandsBrassHint: Optional. Brass-cased loads cost x3 the base price (Blackhand's Guide) instead of x2 (Core rulebook). Default off (Core).
SETTINGS.ShoppingEnabledHint: Master toggle for the Shopping feature. When on, a 'Shop' button appears on character sheets and shops/purchases become available. Off by default (opt-in).
SETTINGS.PlayersCanShopHint: When off, only the GM can buy; players are directed to ask the GM. Keeps gear from appearing out of thin air.
SETTINGS.ShopBuySourceHint: What players can buy from when buying directly: the full catalog (all compendia), or only shops the GM has published.
SETTINGS.ShopAllowHomebrewHint: Off by default. When on, community / non-canon / cross-system items become available in the shop, where the GM can enable individual sources for players. Core and official R.Talsorian books are unaffected by this.
SETTINGS.ShopShowSource: Show item sources in the shop
SETTINGS.ShopShowSourceHint: Show a small badge on each shop item naming the book/source it comes from. Per-user — turn it off if you prefer cleaner rows.
SETTINGS.IpSystemHint: Off by default (free skill editing). Simple = one IP pool per character. RAW = the full per-skill Improvement Points tracker (GM-attributed awards, banked-per-skill, self-service level-ups).
SETTINGS.IpAwardModelHint: Manual = the GM types IP per skill use (RAW). Auto baseline = the GM ticks success on a queued roll and a fixed IP is granted automatically (the GM can still add bonus IP).
SETTINGS.IpAutoBaselineAmountHint: IP granted per GM-marked success when the award model is Auto baseline.
SETTINGS.IpThrottleHint: Optional secondary cap on farming one skill. Off = GM polices manually (default). Hard cap = one award per skill per Apply cycle. Diminishing = each further award on the same skill this cycle is halved.
SETTINGS.IpSkillLockModeHint: Who controls the skill-lock that prevents hand-editing skill levels/IP (rolling and confirm-button level-ups always work). Owner = the player. GM = the GM only. Mutual = a player soft-lock plus a GM hard-lock the player can't override.
SETTINGS.IpShowPendingHint: Show the GM-only “pending IP” pip on skill rows (pending IP is hidden from players until applied). Per-user.

CYBERPUNK.CatalogSupplementsHint: Tick to include a source book in the catalog players see. Hidden items still show here (dimmed).
CYBERPUNK.CatalogFooter: Prices are the Core catalog cost. Ammo uses the Buy Ammo button. Cyberware charges surgery + rolls Humanity on purchase. Clothing prices by style.

CYBERPUNK.CatalogBooksEyeHint: Click a book's eye to show or hide its items from players. The filters here only change your own view.
CYBERPUNK.CatalogBookVisibleHint: Eye on = players can see & buy this book's items in the catalog. Eye off = GM-only. (This is catalog-wide visibility; stock custom shops to sell per-shop.)
CYBERPUNK.CatalogHomebrewOff: Enable “Allow homebrew content” in System Settings to use these.

CYBERPUNK.ShopOnlyHint: Show only the items already added to this shop.
CYBERPUNK.ShopPreviewHint: Open the storefront the way players see it.
CYBERPUNK.ShopShowToPlayersHint: Open the shop to players and post a chat link they can click to browse and buy.
CYBERPUNK.ShopAlreadyStocked: That item is already in the shop.
CYBERPUNK.ShopBuildFooter: Search the catalog and ＋Add items to stock this shop. Set a per-item price (blank = catalog), Unlimited or a finite quantity, and tick Style-priced for clothing. Show to Players when ready.
CYBERPUNK.ShopManageHint: Switch back to the shop builder (GM).

CYBERPUNK.ShopCtxHint: Click to open · right-click for options

CYBERPUNK.ShopQtyHint: Stock quantity — type a number for limited stock (no need to turn ∞ off first). Use the ∞ button for unlimited.
CYBERPUNK.ShopStockAllHint: Set the stock of EVERY item in this shop at once.
CYBERPUNK.ShopStockAllApplyHint: Set every item's stock to this number (limited).
CYBERPUNK.ShopBulkAddHint: Add every item currently listed below to this shop (search/filter first to narrow it).
CYBERPUNK.ShopBulkAddConfirm: Add {n} items to this shop? That's everything currently shown — search or filter the list first if you only want some.
CYBERPUNK.ShopBulkNone: Everything currently shown is already stocked.
CYBERPUNK.ShopClearVendorHint: Remove every item from this shop's stock.

CYBERPUNK.AutoNotice.Title: Cyberpunk 2020 — Setup & What's New
CYBERPUNK.AutoNotice.Intro: This world has the Cyberpunk 2020 combat automation system available. To protect existing characters, most combat automation is OFF by default — enable what your table wants in Game Settings → Configure Settings → System.
CYBERPUNK.AutoNotice.OptInHeading: ⚙ Opt-in automation — OFF by default; enable what you want
CYBERPUNK.AutoNotice.AblationDesc: Armor SP decreases by 1 per penetrating hit. Permanently modifies armor items.
CYBERPUNK.AutoNotice.LimbDesc: More than 8 net damage to a limb triggers an immediate Death Save.
CYBERPUNK.AutoNotice.DeathSaveDesc: Mortal characters are prompted automatically on their turn.
CYBERPUNK.AutoNotice.StunDesc: Unconscious characters are prompted to recover each turn.
CYBERPUNK.AutoNotice.MultiActionDesc: Each action beyond the first pre-fills −3 in the attack modifier dialog.
CYBERPUNK.AutoNotice.LayerEvDesc: Wearing 2+ armor pieces at the same location reduces REF.
CYBERPUNK.AutoNotice.HeadDoublingDesc: A hit to the Head doubles the FINAL damage, after armor (SP) and BTM resolve (CP2020 p.103). Turn it off in settings if your table skips this rule.
CYBERPUNK.AutoNotice.CombatItem2: Cover SP field in damage dialog
CYBERPUNK.AutoNotice.CombatItem3: 🎯 Aim, ⏸ Wait, 🛡 Dodge, ⛨ Parry, ➕ Action buttons
CYBERPUNK.AutoNotice.CombatItem4: Stun and death save prompts after damage
CYBERPUNK.AutoNotice.CombatItem11: Automated rangefinding: range category set from token distance — ON by default (toggle in Game Settings → System)
CYBERPUNK.AutoNotice.BeyondItem1: Vehicles & ACPA: drive/pilot, vehicle combat, weapon mounts (+ optional Maximum Metal rules)
CYBERPUNK.AutoNotice.BeyondItem2: Shopping: searchable catalog, GM custom shops, drag an item onto a sheet to buy
CYBERPUNK.AutoNotice.BeyondItem3: Ammunition: buy by caliber + load right from the catalog (box pricing)
CYBERPUNK.AutoNotice.BeyondItem4: Tear-off sheet tabs: hold a tab and drag it into its own window
CYBERPUNK.AutoNotice.BeyondItem5: Gear list: drag to reorder; drag off the sheet to delete
CYBERPUNK.AutoNotice.BeyondItem6: Reputation & Facedown panel on the combat tab
CYBERPUNK.AutoNotice.SettingsHint: Open Game Settings → Configure Settings → System to review combat options.
CYBERPUNK.IpTrackerFooter: Queue rows come from skill rolls. Enter IP (or tick success), then Apply to release pending IP to players. Pending IP is hidden from players until applied.
CYBERPUNK.IpQueueEmpty: No skill rolls waiting. Rolls appear here as players use skills.
CYBERPUNK.IpThrottleReset: IP throttle reset for a new cycle.
CYBERPUNK.IpLockGmOnly: Only the GM can change the skill lock in this mode.
CYBERPUNK.IpPendingPip: Pending IP (GM only, hidden from players until applied)
CYBERPUNK.AmmoBuyAtShop: Ammunition must be purchased at a shop — see your GM.
SETTINGS.AutoFumbleOnlyJam: Automatic weapons: jam only on fumble
SETTINGS.AutoFumbleOnlyJamHint: Works only if the Fumble Table is enabled. If enabled, automatic weapons ignore the fumble table and only check for a jam using weapon reliability.
CYBERPUNK.Fumble.ReflexCombat.Title: Reflex (Combat)
CYBERPUNK.Fumble.ReflexCombat.1_4: 1–4. No fumble. You just screw up.
CYBERPUNK.Fumble.ReflexCombat.6: 6. Weapon discharges or strikes something harmless.
CYBERPUNK.Fumble.ReflexCombat.7: 7. Weapon jams, or knocks you to the ground for 1 round.
CYBERPUNK.Fumble.ReflexCombat.9_10: 9–10. You manage to wound a member of your own party.
CYBERPUNK.Fumble.ReflexAthletics.Title: Reflex (Athletics)
CYBERPUNK.Fumble.ReflexAthletics.1_4: 1–4. No fumble. You just mess up and make an idiot of yourself.
CYBERPUNK.Fumble.ReflexAthletics.5_7: 5–7. You fail miserably. Take 1 point in minor damage (sprain, fall, stumble), plus make a Save vs. Stun.
CYBERPUNK.Fumble.ReflexAthletics.8_10: 8–10. You fail abysmally. If a physical action, take 1D6 in damage from falling or strained muscles. Also make a roll vs Stun at -1.
CYBERPUNK.Fumble.ControlLoss.Title: Control Loss Table
CYBERPUNK.Fumble.ControlLoss.1_2: 1–2. Skid or slew; no other result.
CYBERPUNK.Fumble.ControlLoss.3_4.Ground: 3–4. Major skid; slide 1D10x10 feet sideways in direction of travel.
CYBERPUNK.Fumble.ControlLoss.3_4.Aircraf: 3–4. Aircraft stalls, losing 1D10x50 feet of altitude.
CYBERPUNK.Fumble.ControlLoss.5_6.Ground: 5–6. Roll ground vehicle after sliding 1D10x10 feet sideways in direction of travel; take 5D6 damage.
CYBERPUNK.Fumble.ControlLoss.5_6.Aircraf: 5–6. Aircraft goes into spin, lose 1D10x100 feet of altitude.
CYBERPUNK.Fumble.Tech.Title: Tech (Repair or create)
CYBERPUNK.Fumble.Tech.1_4: 1–4. No fumble. You just can't get it together.
CYBERPUNK.Fumble.Tech.5_7: 5–7. You not only fail, you make it worse! You drop the tools you're working with, or you lose your grip and damage the thing you're working with even more. Raise the Difficulty by 5 points and try again.
CYBERPUNK.Fumble.Tech.8_10: 8–10. Wow. Did you ever blow it! You damaged the device or creation beyond repair. Buy a new one.
CYBERPUNK.Fumble.Emp.Title: EMP (Convince, Fast talk, Seduce)
CYBERPUNK.Fumble.Emp.1_4: 1–4. No fumble. They just won't buy it.
CYBERPUNK.Fumble.Emp.5_6: 5–6. So much for your people skills. You not only don't convince them; you leave them totally cold (-4 to your next EMP die roll) to any other suggestion you might have.
CYBERPUNK.Fumble.Emp.7_10: 7–10. Yow! You blew it royally. You not only didn't convince them, but now they're actually violently opposed to anything you want to do. Roll 1D10. On a 1–4, they actually attempt to do you physical harm.
CYBERPUNK.Fumble.EmpExtra.1_4: they actually attempt to do you physical harm.
CYBERPUNK.Fumble.EmpExtra.5_10: they are violently opposed and resist you.
CYBERPUNK.Fumble.Int.Title: INT (Figure out, Notice, catch a clue)
CYBERPUNK.Fumble.Int.1_4: 1–4. No fumble. You just don't know how to do it. You don't know what's going on. You carry on, oblivious to higher concerns.
CYBERPUNK.Fumble.Int.5_7: 5–7. You don't know anything about what's going on and you haven't a clue about how to do anything about it. Make a Convince check at -2 to see if anyone else notices how dumb you are.
CYBERPUNK.Fumble.Int.8_10: 8–10. Wow, are you oblivious. You not only don't know what's going on or anything about the subject, but everyone knows how ignorant you are.
CYBERPUNK.Fumble.AutoWeaponOnlyJam: Automatic weapons: fumble table is ignored; only a Reliability jam check is made.
CYBERPUNK.Fumble.ReliabilityResult.NoJam: lucky you, it didn’t jam - just a misfire
CYBERPUNK.Fumble.DischargeApplied: Result: the weapon discharged (ammo is now 0).
CYBERPUNK.Fumble.DischargeNotApplied: Result: lucky you, it didn’t discharge - just a misfire

CYBERPUNK.AmmoLockerHint: Opens the ammunition purchasing dialog for the owning character.
